_note: Complaint codebook for the SA solar-owner complaint-mining run. Tags are added ONLY when at least one logged item supports them. 'provisional' tags may be merged/split before the final tally; any merge is applied through tag_map in the final tally, never by editing evidence rows.

savings_below_expectation.definition: Owner reports electricity cost/units bought did not fall as expected after install, or system cost exceeds the saving.

installer_trust_scam_fear.definition: Prospective buyer or owner distrusts installers/financiers/pricing (scam fear, suspicious contract terms, bad review-site reputation) when choosing a provider.

financing_rent_to_own_terms.definition: Rent-to-own/financed solar: monthly cost vs saving, price escalation, buy-out markup, lock-in or exit fees, contract opacity.

workmanship_defects.definition: Installer workmanship or safety defects (wrong/non-spec DB parts, ungrounded system, fire hazard, unsealed roof penetrations).

municipal_fixed_charge_solar_owners.definition: Fixed/connection/tariff charges that remain or rise for homes with solar.

grid_connection_cost_delay.definition: High cost or long wait for a new grid connection/approvals, pushing owners off-grid.

repair_downtime_no_fallback.definition: Fear or experience of having no power while equipment fails and is repaired, esp. no grid fallback or no loan unit.

installer_aftersales_unresponsive.definition: Installer/seller unresponsive or deflects responsibility after payment/installation (unanswered calls/WhatsApps, hand-offs, blame-shifting).

warranty_repair_delay_runaround.definition: Brand/distributor support or warranty repair: months-long repairs, parts awaited, untraceable job numbers, unanswered escalations, claims bounced between parties, or unhelpful agents.

inverter_fault_recurring.definition: Inverter hardware/firmware faults that recur or are not fixed after repair (error codes, shutdowns, flicker).

battery_failure_degradation.definition: Battery swelling, BMS faults, premature failure or capacity problems.

repeat_callout_fees.definition: Paying repeated call-out/labour fees for faults that remain unresolved or should be under warranty.

firmware_update_failure.definition: Remote or firmware update bricks or destabilises a working system.

system_overpromised_mismatch.definition: Delivered system capacity/performance does not match what was sold or advertised.

coc_compliance_integrity.definition: Certificate-of-compliance process unreliable (CoC electrician did not inspect, approved-inverter list issues).

grid_voltage_issues.definition: High or unstable municipal voltage tripping or stressing equipment.

installation_delays_lead_time.definition: Installation scheduling delays, long lead times, late arrivals, repeated visits.

refund_returns_refused.definition: Seller refuses return/refund of defective goods despite consumer-protection rights.

replacement_unit_quality.definition: Loan/replacement units are used, a different brand, or also defective.

warranty_verification_serial.definition: Cannot verify serial number/warranty status; units supplied without warranty stickers.

installer_misconfiguration_settings.definition: Owner discovers the installer configured the system incorrectly (CT coil position, discharge %, overnight grid-charge, phase layout) so expected savings do not materialise; fixing needs a second paid opinion.

billing_debit_order_errors.definition: Rent-to-own/finance billing problems: debits after cancellation, misallocated payments, unactioned debit-order changes, promised refunds not paid, no reachable accounts department.

municipal_billing_metering_mismatch.definition: Municipal billing/metering treats solar generation as grid consumption or needs a bidirectional/prepaid meter, undermining savings; not explained up front by the provider.

warranty_claim_rejected.definition: Warranty claim rejected with vague or contradictory reasons (e.g. 'misuse'), no failure explanation given.

inverter_battery_compat_config.definition: Inverter/battery/logger compatibility or configuration problems (BMS comms, current limits, odd readings, loggers) that owners must debug themselves.

monitoring_app_issues.definition: Monitoring/alerting gaps: apps or portals offline, inaccurate, too complex, or missing alerts; owners rely on extra tools or notice faults late.

cannot_verify_installation_quality.definition: Owner cannot judge whether the install/configuration is correct or whether the system performs as sold; relies on the installer's word or pays for a second opinion; problems found only after months or years.

_clusters_note: POST-HOC grouping (made after seeing the tag counts) for interpretation only. The pre-committed ranking is tag-level; clusters never change it.
